review.title: Hexamine C1: scoped reference correspondence and ambiguity diagnostic
review.independence_basis: The parent read the current record, retained primary passages, complete native reference routes and exact staged diff before applying. A separate peer independently verified both source configurations, all captured source inputs, the 505 candidate and its receipt before application. This saved assessment remains a partial technical and provenance review.
review.summary: The two C1 source stocks retain their NCBI identities and biological claims. The Brucella pseudintermedia descriptor now records the native species-ID correspondence to Ochrobactrum pseudintermedium with 18 reference genomes and fraction 1.0. The genus-only Ochrobactrum descriptor retains all three ordered native alternatives as AMBIGUOUS. The guarded M5 write, two native inline events, separate sidecar and eight actual commands are bound without inferring experimental stock genomes or scientific completion.
review.scope_description: The two selected taxonomy descriptors, reference-population and source-stock boundaries, exact native persistence, append-only history and scoped validation. Existing C1 experimental claims are preserved rather than newly certified.
review.selection: CommunityMech:000505 is the single end-to-end canary for the eight-record ambiguity preparation. No other member of that preparation is applied before this saved review, complete checkpoint and actual successor proof are verified.
limitations: Partial technical and provenance assessment with scientific_review:false. Passing these validators does not complete scientific review, full QC, reference-snippet coverage or the broader campaign.

Primary coverage consists of retained abstract and selected Methods/Results passages, the Table 1 roster and Table 2 endpoints. No new figure-pixel, supplementary-sequence, exact-stock genome or complete-paper review is claimed.

Source partial-16S identification of SRCHD05 and SRCHD06 does not demonstrate their membership in reference genome clusters. Preserve NCBI Brucella pseudintermedia while explicitly recording the differing GTDB name; this does not constitute formal renaming.

The 18 genomes and fraction 1.0 describe the pinned species reference population. The three genus alternatives are all retained, without choosing the unsuffixed genus, borrowing the other stock's species or inventing an ambiguity-route genome denominator.

The table SHA256 identifies exact bytes. File mtime and native legacy mapping-source prose do not verify an upstream GTDB release. Local NCBI file-stat observations are not a database content hash or release assertion.

C1 is the 1:1 SRCHD05/SRCHD06 suspended culture, distinct from C2-C5 and six-stock C6. Preserve 37-degree culture, separate 24/48/72-hour bulk endpoints, individual-isolate kinetics and absence of directed intermember arrows. Organic nutrients, substrate/COD changes and ammonia production do not establish complete mineralization, reciprocal benefit or measured interspecies flux.

The earlier deep-audit bundle's completeness metrics remain historical evidence, not fresh paper-level support. Every original quote, discussion, source stock, biological field and prior event remains unchanged.

Strict historical successor admission, generated pages and combined full QC require separate evidence. Batch 139's existing biological assertions and history/snippet/participant mutation controls must remain effective when the accepted successor is admitted.

assessments.topic: Separate C1 source stocks and partial-16S scope
assessments.summary: Preserve SRCHD05 and genus-only SRCHD06 as the two distinct C1 members. Their source identification and 1:1 formulation do not assign exact reference genomes or demonstrate interspecies flux.

assessments.topic: Differing species reference and complete genus ambiguity
assessments.summary: The pinned native resolver reproduces the 18/1.0 species reference and all three genus alternatives. NCBI identity and study-stock labels remain unchanged; no genus alternative is selected and no stock assembly or verified crosswalk release is inferred.

assessments.topic: Actual bounded persistence with science retained
assessments.summary: Only the accepted classification, statuses, ambiguity options and two native events changed. The new sidecar and eight actual scoped commands bind the persisted bytes. Existing biology and history remain intact; strict successor integration and full scientific/QC completion are separate.
